input_manifests.role: calendar context, not inherited whole-day eligibility

vp.allocation: Sequential uniform volume to all touched absolute rows, including high boundary
vp.value_area: Single adjacent-row expansion, upper ties; lower coordinates
vp.zero_volume: Retain Pine reported levels across init until positive mass

sessions.weekly_boundary: Monday trading date; normal Sunday 18:00 NY, exchange-session inference not independent TradingView-feed certification
sessions.weekly_scope: All observed chart minutes, including out-of-futures observations
sessions.pdh_pdl_and_hvn_scope: Futures minutes only; do not create a session on dates with none

hvn.equal_strength_rule: Deterministic lower candidate order; external Pine sort stability not certified

availability.snapshot: Before each evening minute, completed prior bars only
availability.historical_gate: First futures minute close, then first close >=15 elapsed minutes later; replace last-bar gate
availability.export_window: 18:00-00:00 NY; reconstruct references from all source bars

quality.holidays: Labels only, no inherited whole-day exclusion

coordinates.adjusted: Final retrospective adjusted snapshot, converted to current raw coordinates for comparison; execution always raw
coordinates.price_grid: Validate fixed-point quarter alignment, recover exact binary quarter points

node_identity.match: Overlapping bands and centers within 2 points
node_identity.split_merge: Ambiguous flag, retain lineage; must not manufacture first touches
